title: Saga 2.3 final verification omits the cushion-1 (skimmed-surplus) buffer check despite the protocol-wide 'one buffer' framing
description: The set-aside / buffer is ONE protocol-wide concept realized by two cushions (owner clarification): cushion-2 is the 10% strategy-level withholding to the staker (`setAsideBufferSize==10`), and cushion-1 is the skimmed DOLA/USDC surplus that 2.2 step 8 transfers to the staker (`setAsideBufferRecipient==STAKER` / cushion landing). 2.3's declared final verification gate asserts only the strategy half (`setAsideBufferSize==10`, cushion-2) and never asserts that cushion-1 landed nor that `setAsideBufferRecipient==STAKER`. A green 2.3 _verify therefore declares the migration complete even though it covers only half of the protocol-wide buffer concept.
impact: None at direct risk. Cushion-2 is independently in place and asserted; cushion-1 is fungible idle balance the owner can re-transfer manually. No drain, no lock, no protocol availability impact — 2.3 itself runs and is safe. The gap is a verification-completeness / state-handling defect: the declared final gate over-trusts a green result because it never asserts the cushion-1 (skimmed-surplus) half of the buffer. If 2.2 completes steps 1-7 but reverts/is interrupted at step 8 (the buffer transfer), 2.3 still passes all gates green while the protocol-wide buffer is short by the entire skimmed surplus and no gate flags it.
attackPath: 1. 2.2 completes steps 1-7 but reverts or is interrupted at step 8 (the cushion-1 buffer transfer to the staker).
3. 2.3 _verify asserts only `setAsideBufferSize==10` (cushion-2) and passes all gates green.
4. Migration is declared complete while the protocol-wide buffer is short by the entire skimmed surplus, and no gate flagged it nor checked `setAsideBufferRecipient==STAKER`.
recommendation: Extend 2.3 _verify to assert the cushion-1 half of the buffer concept end-to-end: confirm the skimmed DOLA/USDC surplus actually landed at the staker (cushion landing) and assert `setAsideBufferRecipient==STAKER`, so a green final gate proves the protocol-wide 'one buffer' is whole rather than only its strategy half.
evidence: Fork-verified end-state (script-auditor, run-18): 2.3 add/remove executes cleanly, zero unintended writes, old strategies fully drained before retirement, idempotent. _verify (L99-101) asserts `setAsideBufferSize==10` only; no assertion of cushion-1 landing or `setAsideBufferRecipient==STAKER`.
